title: Pryv adapter manifest
description: Self-description served by an adapter at GET <base>/manifest.json. A Pryv core advertises only the adapter's base URL in /service/info; clients fetch the manifest for the details.

name.description: Short adapter name, unique within a deployment.

type.description: Adapter class — the external standard it bridges (e.g. 'calendar', 'fhir', 'mail').

ui.description: Path to the web UI, relative to the adapter base URL.

baseTemplate.description: Recommended. The adapter's base URL in the platform's {username} template form, as /service/info.adapters lists it (e.g. 'https://{username}.example.com/adapter/calendar/'); ends with '/'. A client fills the placeholder with the account's username (or address alias) to address that account. Adapter-specific endpoint members are relative to it, or absolute in the same template form.

platformBase.description: Optional. The adapter's base URL at a platform address (e.g. 'https://reg.example.com/adapter/calendar/'), for callers that address no account; ends with '/', no placeholder.
